summary.one_liner: OpenRCT2 is an open-source re-implementation of the 2002 park-management game RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 that requires the original game's files to play.
summary.what_it_does: The project re-creates RollerCoaster Tycoon 2's amusement park simulation, where players build rides, shops and facilities while managing profit, park reputation and guest happiness. It supports scenario play with objectives and time limits, and sandbox play with optional no restrictions or finance. The README says it adds modern platform support, an improved interface, better guest and staff AI, more editing tools, increased limits, and cooperative multiplayer. It also brings back mechanics from the first RollerCoaster Tycoon, such as the in-game mountain tool and the "have fun" objective. Pre-built downloads come from the project website, a cross-platform launcher, Flatpak, and several Linux, BSD and package-manager repositories. The README also includes build guides for Linux, macOS, Windows, WSL and MSYS2.
use_cases: play RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 on modern computers
build and manage an amusement park
run original RCT2 scenarios with the original game files
contribute code, translations, graphics or audio to an open-source game
install the game on Linux via Flatpak or native packages
how_to_run: Obtain the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files (available on Steam or GOG.com) and point OpenRCT2 to them
Download a pre-built build or the launcher from the OpenRCT2 website
On Linux, install the latest Flatpak from Flathub
Alternatively, install a native package such as openrct2 on Arch Linux, games/openrct2 on FreeBSD, or openrct2 on NixOS
To build from source, follow the platform guides in the README (Linux, macOS with CMake, Windows, WSL, MSYS2 MinGW)
notable: Open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 that needs the original game files
Supports both scenario play and sandbox play
Adds cooperative multiplayer, increased limits and more editing tools
Releases are code-signed through SignPath Foundation
Plug-in directory and plug-in development documentation are linked
caveats: Requires original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files, which must be bought separately from Steam or GOG.com
Building from source requires platform-specific setup described in separate guides
Release signing is limited to members of the development team
